correctness.rationale: The claimed exact R_n=tr(T^n)-2[p(1-q)]^n follows from cyclic two-state cut/spoke automaton: every connected state has a unique state history, but all-rim-open/all-spokes-closed has two and must be subtracted. Re-derived T with entries p(1-q)+(1-p)q,pq;1-p,p and checked independent full 2^(2n) weighted hub reachability for n=3,4,5 at p=2/3,q=1/4: respectively 29/64,1049/2304,3949/9216, matching traces exactly. Joint Bernoulli point-process convergence for n(1-p)->mu,nq->lambda, continuum cut-arc/seed mapping, and matrix exponential with generator [[-(lambda+mu),lambda],[mu,-mu]] prove weak fraction limit, full-atom formula and expected mass (including lambda=mu=0). All-atoms boundaries checked conceptually; lattice-valued S_n does not converge in total variation to a mixed continuous law.
